title: WebPilot: A Versatile and Autonomous Multi-Agent System for Web Task Execution with Strategic Exploration

layout.note: Two tinted zones side by side inside one outer frame: a grey Global Optimization zone at left (title at the bottom) and a pale green Local Optimization zone at right (title at the top right). In the local zone the agents and four trees sit on top and two large framed boxes below are tied to the RENE and DES trees by thin wedge lines. A six-arrow legend sits at the bottom of the global zone.

lesson: Give each agent role its own robot avatar with a prop, put two levels of the method in two tinted zones, and zoom the new search phases into framed boxes that show a real example. Reuse the legend arrow colours as the fill of the boxes they describe.
